message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal statutory holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday – or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend – thereby giving you a three‑day break.)

| Holiday | Actual Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---------|--------------------|--------------------------|--------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Sun Jan 1 – Tue Jan 3** | The holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 (Ontario) | — | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** | Dates vary by province (e.g., BC Feb 20, AB Feb 20, SK Feb 20, ON Feb 20). |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | The holiday is observed on Monday Jul 3 because it fell on a Saturday. |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | The holiday is observed on Monday Dec 25. |

> **Provinces & Territories**  
> Some provinces/territories have additional statutory holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patricks’ Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can pull the full list for that jurisdiction.

---

### Quick‑look Calendar View

```
2023 Long Weekends (Canada)

Jan 1–3   (New Year’s Day observed Jan 2)
Feb 18–20 (Family Day – Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.)
Apr 7–9   (Good Friday)
May 20–22 (Victoria Day)
Jul 1–3   (Canada Day observed Jul 3)
Sep 2–4   (Labour Day)
Oct 7–9   (Thanksgiving)
Dec 23–25 (Christmas Day)
```

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app, or let me know if you’d like the data in CSV/JSON format!
